source_policy: Generate each poster directly from original screenshots only. Never reference earlier generated posters.
campaign_style: 清新淡雅；统一字标、字体与留白；各主题使用不同浅色背景。

posters.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a NEW Taleqube brand campaign poster directly from supplied ORIGINAL APP SCREENSHOTS ONLY. Clean, fresh, understated, elegant, generous negative space. Unified campaign typography: rounded geometric sans-serif Taleqube wordmark in small size at top-left, medium-weight Chinese headline, consistent generous margins and fine thin rules. Soft natural light and very subtle paper texture. Low saturation colors, no dark backgrounds, neon, heavy shadows or ornament. Screenshots are supporting inserts: preserve their real UI and artwork faithfully; crop the screenshot to the relevant content; do not invent UI, duplicate controls or alter progress. No hardware/device bezels: use sharp frameless rectangular panels with small corner radius and delicate shadow. Preserve original screen proportions without stretching. Replace AniShelf within screenshot only with Taleqube when visible. Brand is exactly Taleqube (T-a-l-e-q-u-b-e). Use dark indigo text #332B56. No other logos invented. Landscape 16:9 hero. Warm ivory background with a whisper of lilac at lower edge. Large Taleqube wordmark and exact headline '把热爱，收藏成宇宙。' at left; subtitle '电影 · 剧集 · 动漫 · 书籍'. At right layer a wide landscape iPad screenshot (image 1) and tall iPhone screenshot (image 2) as frameless flat panels. iPad stays 4:3, iPhone stays 1260:2736. Main imagery large, no desktop/Mac screenshot invented. Footer exact '为 13 英寸 iPad 与 iPhone Air 设计' and 'Mac 现阶段有限支持'. An understated tiny three-face cube symbol near wordmark, lilac/apricot/cream.
